page: Microsoft Azure D32nds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration belonging to the Dndv6 series. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and utilizes dedicated Intel x86_64 processors. It is configured with 32 virtual CPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. As an accelerator-free instance, it includes zero GPUs.

A primary architectural characteristic of the D32nds_v6 is its integrated high-speed local storage. The server includes 1888 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Premium Storage. This design provides low-latency ephemeral disk access directly on the host node, which eliminates external block storage overhead for temporary files, swap space, and scratch data caches. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

From a cost-efficiency standpoint, the inclusion of 1888 GB of onboard NVMe capacity reduces dependency on provisioned external disks for temporary high-throughput input/output operations. The standard 4 GB per vCPU ratio makes it balanced for workloads requiring concurrent computational power coupled with high local storage throughput. The primary operational tradeoff is the ephemeral nature of the attached local NVMe drives, necessitating architectural decoupling of stateful persistence from scratch storage.

Microsoft Azure D32nds_v6 is suitable for database engines requiring fast temporary tablespaces, intermediate data processing, high-traffic web applications, continuous integration build nodes, and general enterprise application hosting.
description: Microsoft Azure D32nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine within the Dndv6 family, powered by dedicated Intel x86_64 processors on the Microsoft Hyper-V platform. It is provisioned with 32 vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. The instance includes 1888 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations, addressing workloads that require rapid local disk throughput and low access latencies without adding extra local hardware peripherals. It does not incorporate GPU acceleration. Due to its balance of compute density and bundled high-speed local disk capacity, the D32nds_v6 delivers strong resource efficiency for high-IOPS scratch operations. It is well suited for enterprise application backends, relational and NoSQL databases using local caching tiers, data transformation pipelines, and container cluster host environments.
